key.name: icon-size
key.description: Preferred size of the dock's icons in logical pixels. The dock uses a smaller size if this doesn't fit the screen. Set by dragging a divider.

key.name: style
key.description: Light or dark dock. "system" follows GNOME's style (Settings → Appearance: Default is light, Dark is dark); "light" and "dark" are fixed. The dock is always dark in the overview. Set in the dock's menu (right-click).

key.name: position
key.description: The screen edge the dock sits at, on the primary monitor: "bottom", "left" or "right". Set in the dock's menu (right-click).
